architecture: YOLO11n stride layout as built by Ultralytics 8.4.115 from c_model/yolo11-stride.yaml (C3k2 c3k=True; erratum experiments/aerotrack_v2/ERRATUM_architecture.md), 9-channel input, 2 classes
trained_on: HPC Tesla V100, fp16 autocast (amendment A1), corpus v2 TRAIN

temporal_window.frames: channels 0-2 = frame t-g, 3-5 = frame t, 6-8 = frame t-2g (experiments/aerotrack_v2/scripts/v2lib.window_samples)
temporal_window.sequence_start: missing past frames are replaced by the earliest available frame (training rule)

input.colour: BGR as read by OpenCV, per frame
input.resize: letterbox to 640 x 640 keeping aspect, pad value 114 (b_pipeline/stacked_dataset.letterbox_image)

postprocess.boxes: xyxy in letterboxed pixels -> undo letterbox to source pixels

runtime.recommended_backend: trt_fp16 (TensorRT 11.3, engines are GPU-specific: rebuild on another GPU)
